title: reseal rung 1 clears a seal-red trouble its proven green no longer supports
intention: The reseal door's rung 1 clears a proof's seal-red trouble when the trouble stands and standing() reads the proof's current bytes proven green, and clears nothing when no such trouble stands or the proof is not proven.
why: Measured 2026-11-10 and again 2026-11-11. seal-red-cairn-devices-codemother-proofs-test-codemother stood at 5x after c42e4e436d6c PROVED, and 'cairn test --reseal' said 'seal still reproduces' and left it standing until CC cleared it by hand. Today seal-red-...-test-clearance-reaches-trouble-through-its-tool stands, raised 15:36Z, while standing() reads that proof proven green. Rung 1 (reseal.py:534) returns without a clear, and validation_store clears only on a verdict change.
how: reseal.py: a helper _clear_a_raise_a_green_settles(proof, rel, raiser, trouble_root) reads {t['id'] for t in store.live(root=trouble_root)} through cairn.devices.trouble.tools.store.store. If trouble_identity(proof) is among them, it calls raiser.clear_trouble(identity, by=CLEARS_FOR, what_changed=...). Any exception leaves the trouble standing. Rung 1 calls it and the returned dict carries 'cleared'. reseal() and reseal_all() gain trouble_root=None.

clauses.claim: a proof sealed green over unchanged bytes whose seal-red stands live at a real TroubleDevice leaves the live list after one rung-1 reseal, and the tester never runs
a proven proof with no standing seal-red gets no clear from rung 1
a proof whose fingerprint moved keeps its standing seal-red through a reseal that does not run green

decisions.text: D1: the helper sits at module level in reseal.py, and the raiser is defaulted inside it (ModuleRaiser('tester')) only when a clear is due. Rung 1's return gains 'cleared': <identity or None>. reseal_all forwards trouble_root. The proof gains three test_ teeth in test_reseal_door.py, and PROVES gains b65e965237f3: 1, 2 and 3 for them. Each tooth uses a scratch component and a real TroubleDevice(root=<scratch>/troubles) behind a raiser wired to it, as tooth 9 does.

measured.saw: standing() reads test_clearance_reaches_trouble_through_its_tool.py proven green while its seal-red raised 15:36Z stays live; the tester trail holds 80,880 records

verdicts.claim: the three falsifier clauses each hold as a tooth

verdicts.discriminating_observation: bin/cairn test sealed test_reseal_door.py green, 12 of 12. test_rung_1_clears_... takes a live seal-red off a real TroubleDevice's list with an exploding tester. test_rung_1_clears_nothing_... draws no clear for a neighbour's raise or an absent store. test_a_moved_proof_keeps_... keeps the raise through a timeout. With the rung-1 call mutated to None, the first tooth reds. The hollow reverted reseal.py to 1f914ea284da: 1 measured, 0 hollow.
